title: Signature Specification Spine
description: A Signature-original specification spine: Problem (one page), Invention (the inventive step in one sentence), Embodiments (three, from broad to best mode), and the Claim Support Map (every claim element traced to a paragraph). The spine is drafted before any prose so the specification cannot drift from the claims. Signature-original, labeled Signature.

title: Signature Claim Ladder Sheet
description: A Signature-original one-page claim ladder: the independent claim at top, dependents cascading below with the added limitation of each written in red, so the fallback positions are visible at a glance. The sheet is reviewed by asking of each rung: 'if everything above falls, does this rung still catch the product?' Signature-original.

print('if everything above falls, does THIS rung still catch the product?')

title: Signature Antecedent Audit
description: A Signature-original audit pass: every 'said' and 'the' in the claims is traced back to its first 'a'/'an' introduction, and any noun appearing without introduction is flagged. The audit is done on paper with two highlighters and takes twenty minutes; it kills the most common indefiniteness rejections. Signature-original.

print('audit: trace every "said/the" back to its "a/an" introduction')
print('20 minutes, two highlighters, kills indefiniteness rejections')
provenance: Signature-original composition authored in the Signature system; clearly labeled Signature — it is an original work, not a public record.

title: Signature Method-Step Mapper
description: A Signature-original mapper for method claims: each step gets a row with the observable act, the input, the output, and the infringer's footprint — so the drafter can see whether infringement is actually detectable. Steps with no detectable footprint are rewritten or cut. Signature-original.

title: Signature 112(f) Pairing Sheet
description: A Signature-original pairing sheet: every 'means for' clause in the claims is paired on the same page with the specification paragraph naming its structure. Unpaired means clauses are either given structure or rewritten in structural language. The sheet makes 112(f) a deliberate choice. Signature-original.

title: Signature Figure Checklist

title: Signature Color Photo Protocol
description: A Signature-original protocol for design and plant filings that use photographs: neutral background, scale reference in frame, color-calibration card in the first shot, and the same lighting for every angle. The protocol exists because color and proportion disputes are won or lost on the quality of the figures. Signature-original.

title: Signature Abstract Squeezer
description: A Signature-original abstract drill: draft at 200 words, then cut to 150 by deleting every adjective, then to the final by keeping only field, problem, solution essence, and use. The drill produces abstracts a searcher can triage in thirty seconds. Signature-original.

title: Signature Background Guardrails
description: A Signature-original guardrail set for background sections: state the field, state the problem, stop. No admissions about what is prior art, no characterization of the applicant's own work, no patentability argument. The guardrails are taped to the monitor during drafting. Signature-original.

title: Signature Margin Checker
description: A Signature-original pre-filing margin check: measure every drawing sheet against the USPTO minimums (2.5 cm top/left, 1.5 cm right/bottom), verify numeral height, and confirm black-ink lines with no obscuring shading. Five minutes that prevent the most avoidable office actions. Signature-original.

title: Signature IDS Discipline
